Every game in the prototype is shuffled from a starting number, its seed. We went with a fresh random seed each game. The dev panel shows it, and you can type it back in to replay a game exactly.

**What we need from you:** is a random seed fine? The other way would count up, 1, 2, 3, each time you launch, so the first few games are always the same.

**Why it matters:** it decides whether two playtests start the same way.
